title: Dashboard scorecard demo fidelity
description: Ensure the seeded local demo scorecard and score render reliably in dashboard local mode. Track scorecard-page contract fidelity issues found during browser verification.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Found local dashboard issue where account records loaded without primary-key fields from the local Amplify shim. This prevented `selectedAccount.id` from being populated, so the scorecards page never issued scorecard queries. The local shim should always include manifest primary-key fields in generated selection sets. Browser verification now shows local scorecards and score counts rendering.

comments.author: unknown
comments.text: Board audit 2026-10-17: verified against develop. The local Amplify data shim (dashboard/lib/local-amplify/data.ts) now always selects manifest primary-key fields, so the seeded account, scorecard and score render in local mode. Covered by local-amplify.test.ts (primary-key selection test) and scripts/smoke-local-browser.sh.
